A '''tradeship''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="TEGTW AC 4">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref> The [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] used angular tradeships which were a common sight in both [[Herglic Space/Legends|Herglic Space]] and the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="PGT">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref>
